old_target: The ten ways of thinking partition into two groups. The first group covers a thought, drawn to it, something that struck a chord, who one is shaped by, breaking it down an idea, and it just clicked — together these span a cluster. The second group covers paying attention, an aversion, practice makes perfect, and that reminds me — together these span a separate cluster. Together, these two clusters cover all ten ways of thinking without overlap.

validator_log.target_text: The noetic domain covers two distinct clusters: the first comprises a foundational thought; what speaks to us; what struck a chord; who one is; breaking it down; and what just clicked. The second comprises paying attention; an aversion; practiced rhythm; and a triggered memory.
